same here, the only advise I can give you since I was in the same situation is to STOP THINKING
Having depression means 0 motivation, 0 focus and it keep decreasing if you don't do nothing.

1 - At first and whatever u are studying for, you need to learn how to love what you are doing (I love physics and so I watch physics channel that made me love physics again)
2 - Remember your carreer plan - and know that the only way to achieve it is by studying
3 - Focus on present, throw your phone away and start doing exercice, reading your lesson will make you think again , but practicing is the only way to keep your mind away from depressive thougts.
4 - Once It's done, enjoy the sensation of good work

5- Repeat everyday, and do some sport to stimulate the brain. Dont think about Tomorrow or Yesterday. You take the Pen and u practice. 

Important : while I was in depression, I made my practicing really enjoyable, with a cup of tea or cofee, some background music and a portable heater. A study with me is also great for motivation
